sources.title: SN38 — ChronoLLM - GitHub
sources.snippet: The problem Standard LLMs are trained on data from all time periods. When used for financial backtesting or historical analysis, they suffer from lookahead bias — the model "knows" things that weren't known at the time being analyzed. A model asked to predict 2015 market trends has already seen the 2020 crash.

sources.title: chronollm · PyPI
sources.snippet: ChronoLLM Chat with temporally consistent language models. Each model only knows events up to its vintage year — no future knowledge leaking into your analysis. Install pip install chronollm Setup # Save your HuggingFace token (provided by the ChronoLLM team) chronollm login <your_token> Usage # Chat with a vintage year chronollm 2020 # Chat with a specific model chronollm owner/repo Example ...
